description: Full blood count evaluating red cells, white cells, platelets, and related indices.
Identifies haemoglobin variants including HbA, HbA2, HbF, HbS and screens for thalassaemia and HbA1c.
Assesses blood clotting pathways including PT, APTT, INR, bleeding time and clotting time.
Measures fasting, random, and post-prandial blood glucose as well as OGTT values.
Evaluates kidney performance by measuring urea, creatinine, uric acid, and electrolytes.
Measures sodium, potassium, chloride, bicarbonate, calcium, phosphorus, and magnesium.
Assesses liver health by measuring bilirubin, enzymes, protein, albumin, and related markers.
Measures total cholesterol, LDL, HDL, VLDL, triglycerides, and total lipids to assess cardiovascular risk.
Evaluates heart muscle damage via LDH, CPK, CK-MB, and troponins.
Evaluates thyroid gland and endocrine hormones including TSH, T3, T4, FT3, FT4, cortisol, and sex hormones.
Evaluates iron stores, transport capacity, and saturation via serum iron, TIBC, ferritin, and transferrin.
Rapid immunoassays for CRP, hepatitis, HIV, malaria, dengue, Widal, brucella, and autoimmune markers.
Routine urine analysis covering specific gravity, pH, albumin, glucose, pus cells, and red blood cells.
Evaluates male fertility parameters per WHO 2021 criteria including volume, motility, morphology and pH.
Culture, sensitivity, microscopy, and rapid tests for TB (AFB/Mantoux), fungi, leishmania, and C&S.
Assessment of vitamin D, B12, and folate levels.
Screens for common tumour antigens including PSA, AFP, CEA, CA-125, CA19-9, and acid phosphatase.
